question: How should AI edits and streaming reuse authored commands, selection and application policy?
trigger: Reporter contradiction: leaving unaccepted AI output retains its highlight. User authorizes repairs and an all-job AI regression audit versus main.
requirements: Implicit dismissal cancels and discards unaccepted output without mutating the source or losing the clicked destination; Stop retains every received chunk.
Opening, requests, retry, previews and application share the captured mapped target and preserve Editing unless the user explicitly chose Suggesting.
Each request owns its SDK callbacks, structured response refs and generated comment drafts; stale responses and deleted targets cannot contaminate another request or location.
Preserve rich Markdown/MDX, cross-block replacement, formatting, single-batch history, purple draft rendering, stream indicator, Copilot and both streaming demo modes.

Compare all current AI jobs with the frozen local main source and distinguish retained behavior, intentional changes, repaired regressions and unproved combinations; reproduce the actual reporter interaction.
evidenceReuse: Reused the adopted temporary-preview target and previous immutable production scaling results while rechecking request and dismissal ownership. Independent package and demo workers inspected current source versus local main cce36d378b2f1e5c775dafe1a67c2215165c982c. Preserved initial dismissal reds, buffered Stop/error/late-response reds, static-output failure, and the final Space-trigger failure before its repair. Settled source passes 154 AI/React/integration cases, 135 core slice cases, 11 AI browser cases and 13 streaming/layout browser cases; native Chrome separately replays Escape and immediate typing.
summary: Repair dismissal and bind each AI request to its target, transport and comment drafts; complete the main source parity audit.
alternatives: Restore main-style source mutation and undo on every dismissal: rejected. It couples an unaccepted draft to history and can undo unrelated edits; one temporary draft remains the smallest owner.
Patch only Escape or hide the purple styles: rejected. Outside click, view retirement, late callbacks and comment drafts share the same request lifetime and need canonical cancellation.
Add a new public draft/session/projection layer: rejected. Existing plugin state, mapped anchors, SDK instance lifetime and ordinary apply cover the demonstrated jobs.
Keep the temporary draft, consolidate dismissal and request ownership, and repair cross-leaf application in the canonical slice fitter: adopted and directly verified.
proofLimits: Job-level source audit against local main, not a complete main runtime replay or universal AI certification. Final local source-first Chromium: 24 cases passed across two frozen-source runs (11 in 58.4 s, 13 in 26.5 s). Full MDX 3207 ms, maximum frame gap 58.4 ms. Native Chrome confirms zero draft/authored records after Escape and immediate typing at the restored caret. Live providers, fresh-checkout site-wrapper delivery, native IME/CJK and every root/concurrent-edit combination remain unproved. Source-only AI/core typechecks pass; broad project references retain existing authored TS6307 failures and www has two existing comment harness-name errors. Earlier empty-output proxy passes, HMR-invalidated execution and pre-target-fix dismissal passes do not count as final proof.
